title: Decay paths
subtitle: Every decay step ENSDF records, on the chart of nuclides

segments.caption: Every decay step ENSDF records is a faint line on the chart of nuclides.
One route is lit: everything uranium-238 decays into.
The right panel holds the four natural decay series.
Thorium series: everything thorium-232 decays into.
Neptunium series: extinct in nature, made in reactors.
